digest.component_or_area: plan-review Pass-2 verification gate, LLM structured output routing
propositions: Plan-review Pass-2 prerequisite_verify fails with HTTP 400 ValidationException after commit 6c8daf7945 added native_structured_output=True for sonnet-4-6, routing large contracts (22-36 optional parameters) to Bedrock's JSON Schema compilation which times out at 180s.

The verification contracts carry every field as optional (all have default=), exceeding Anthropic's documented 24-optional-parameter grammar-complexity limit and triggering either 'Grammar compilation timed out' (~185s) or 'Schema is too complex' (~50-60s) rejections.

Both Bedrock (Variant A: 185.6s server-side, Variant B: 0.0s client-side botocore 1.40.61 rejecting unknown 'outputConfig' parameter) and direct-Anthropic fallback (401 rejection) fail, leaving no runtime escape path.

output_mode must gate NativeOutput selection on both stack support (whether installed botocore knows outputConfig) and measured schema complexity bounds (16 optional / 12 union parameters), falling back to PromptedOutput when either gate fails.

The complexity counting must recurse through $defs and nested properties because VerificationOutput's 31 optionals live inside nested Verification/PlanSeverityAttrs/Binary objects, not at the top level, so a non-recursive counter would incorrectly score the contract as 0-1 optionals and silently fix nothing.

The Gerrit LLM-Review code-review gate's code_review_verification contract (36 optionals, pinned model: standard to sonnet-4-6) fails identically, degrading all code-review findings to no-verification and blocking review attestation.
